description: Build Salesforce-anchored personas and journey maps where every persona ties to a Permission Set Group, primary record types, list views, dashboards, automation, and a measured mobile/desktop posture, and journeys walk each task end-to-end with friction tags that drive UX decisions. NOT for stakeholder authority / RACI (use admin/stakeholder-raci-for-sf-projects), NOT for system-side process flows (use admin/process-flow-as-is-to-be), NOT for Lightning page design itself (use admin/lightning-app-builder-advanced or the lightning-record-page-auditor agent), NOT for pure design / UX research disconnected from org artifacts.
inputs: list of user roles and counts in scope (target Permission Set Groups, profiles, record types)
primary tasks each role performs and rough frequency (daily / weekly / monthly)
available org artifacts to anchor against: PSGs, record types, list views, dashboards, automation
measured (not assumed) mobile vs desktop usage split per role
name: persona-and-journey-mapping-sf
official_sources: Object Reference (Winter '27), LightningUsageByAppTypeMetrics — `AppExperience` is "Lightning Experience or Salesforce Mobile"; not available in sandbox orgs; the measured source for `mobile_pct`: object_reference 264 L170407, L170415, L170436.

Platform Events Developer Guide (Winter '27), UriEvent / LightningUriEvent — UriEvent covers "Salesforce Classic only", LightningUriEvent "Lightning Experience only", so neither gives a mobile split: platform_events 264 L28315-28317, L20567-20568.
Object Reference (Winter '27), EventLogFile Lightning Performance event type — covers Lightning Experience and Salesforce mobile app performance: object_reference 264 L123289-123291.
Metadata API Developer Guide (Winter '27), ListView — "Visible only to me" list views are not accessible in Metadata API (Gotcha 3 in SKILL.md): api_meta 264 L46523-46524.
Metadata API Developer Guide (Winter '27), CompactLayout — shown in the Salesforce mobile app and Lightning Experience: api_meta 264 L45323-45324.
Salesforce Help — Salesforce Mobile App Overview: https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.salesforce_app_intro.htm
outputs: persona records (canonical schema) anchored to PSG + record types + list views + dashboards + automation + mobile/desktop posture
per-task journey maps with steps, frequency, friction points tagged from a fixed taxonomy, and desired outcome
a friction-to-fix backlog: which friction points need UI work (Dynamic Forms, Quick Actions, page redesign, list view tuning) vs automation (Flow, validation rule, assignment rule)
handoff JSON consumed by audit-router (lightning_record_page, list_view_search_layout domains), path-designer, and UAT test design
